references.title: Neo G Adjusta Fit Hinged Open Knee Brace
references.snippet: Neo G Adjusta Fit Hinged Open Knee Brace The Neo G Adjusta Fit Hinged Open Knee Brace is an comprehensive option for weak, injured or arthritic knees. Knee pain is a common ailment, and can make even the simplest of actions (such as walking) painful and inconvenient. Your knees are also vulnerable to injury, and while you're trying to heal you're going to need a product that will give you some extra support and protection. The Adjusta Fit Hinged Open Knee Brace effectively uses a hinge mechanism to control flexion and extension movements, meaning you won't run the risk of making your injury worse, and you'll not suffer from the same level of pain and discomfort. About the Neo G Hinged Open Knee Brace The Neo G Hinged Open Knee Brace helps provide firm support to the entire knee complex, with an embedded flexion hinge system to allow restricted flexion and extension within an adjustable range of motion. The adjustable hinged can be adjusted for optimum fit and movement between -10 to 120 degrees of flexion. This helps to reduce over strain of the muscles, tendons, and ligaments involved in flexing and extending the knee joint, which is particularly useful for acute injuries or instability. The durable, heat therapeutic neoprene material also helps soothe arthritic knees, chronic aches and stiffness, for a comfortable user experience. The knee support comes in a universal size, and should fit the majority of people. Features and Benefits of the Adjusta Fit Hinged Open Knee Brace Helps support injured, weak or arthritic knees, pre or post surgery Helps control flexion and extension movements for a prescribed range of motion Innovative hinge system helps reduce over strain of muscles, tendons and ligaments Durable, heat therapeutic neoprene helps with arthritis, chronic aches and stiffness Adjustable easy push dials give an optimal fit and limit movement (between -10 - 120 degrees flexion) Universal size (one-size-fits-most), fits either the left or right leg, and is unisex Sizing of the Neo G Knee Brace The Adjusta Fit Knee Support is one-size-fits-most. To find out whether it will fit you, please measure your thigh circumference 4 inches above the knee. The brace will fit up to a 22" (56cm) circumference. Washing Instructions Remove hinges before washing. Hand wash cold only and dry flat. Do not use fabric softener, do not tumble dry, do not bleach, do not iron. Store in a cool, dry place.

references.title: Post Op Knee Brace
references.snippet: Post-Operative Knee Brace The Post-Operative Knee Brace provides immobilisation and range-of-motion (ROM) control following knee surgery. It features adjustable dial lock hinges and a one-touch bottom for ease of adjustment, thus providing optimal support during the course of healing. Indications of the Knee Brace The Post-Operative Knee Brace has been designed to provide support following surgery. It is suitable for use after operations on specific parts of the knee, including: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL) Medial collateral ligament (MCL) Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) It provides immobilisation for injured ligaments, while offering ROM control to ensure suitable healing of the ligaments following surgery. Functions of the Knee Brace The knee brace provides collateral stabilisation through the use of long side bars, which prevents valgus and varus deviation. It also prevents hyperextension and limits ROM through adjustable dial lock hinges. This is done by simply pressing and rotating the settings, ensuring that wearing the brace is as free from stress as possible. With a one-push bottom providing easy length adjustment, the brace is straightforward to alter to suit changing requirements during recovery.
